full_citation: Yao Z, van Velthoven CTJ, Kunst M, et al. A high-resolution transcriptomic and spatial atlas of cell types in the whole mouse brain. Nature. 2023;624(7991):317-332.
what_we_used: Allen Brain Cell Atlas WMB-10X scRNA-seq: cell metadata, gene metadata, taxonomy, and regional log2 cell-by-gene .h5ad matrices. This is the quantitative evidence behind every gene (max_pct, max_mean, specificity).
raw_data_note: YES. Official ABC Atlas processed cell-by-gene log2 matrices (.h5ad) plus metadata were downloaded with abc_atlas_access (AWS public bucket allen-brain-cell-atlas, manifest releases/20240330). NOT sequencer FASTQ. For this panel: 226886 cells (ORBm 106122 from Isocortex shards; BMAp 120764 from STR shard). Local cache ~96 GB of regional .h5ad files.

full_citation: Hochgerner H, Singh S, Tibi M, et al. Neuronal types in the mouse amygdala and their transcriptional response to fear conditioning. Nat Neurosci. 2023;26:2237-2249.
what_we_used: Published posterior-BMA VGLUT1 type markers (Meis2/Calb2/Dcn, Cartpt, Mpped1/Tac1, Cd36, Gpr101, St8sia2, Ptpru, Htr2c) and Fezf1 as the MEA vs BMA discriminator. Stands in for Dan's amygdala list until that arrives.
raw_data_note: NO. We used the published marker lists from the paper text/figures. Their ArrayExpress matrix (E-MTAB-12096) was not downloaded. Every Hochgerner gene that made the panel was then re-checked in Allen WMB-10X.

full_citation: Lui JH, Nguyen ND, Grutzner SM, et al. Differential encoding in prefrontal cortex projection neuron classes across cognitive tasks. Cell. 2021;184(2):489-506.e26.
what_we_used: Published OFC/PFC cluster markers: Pld5 and Ackr3 (OFC vs mPFC), Otof (L2/3), Npr3 (deep L5), Tshz2, Rbp4, Cd44. Stands in for Jesse's ORBm list until that arrives.
raw_data_note: NO. We used the published cluster-exemplar genes from the paper. Their SMART-seq2 matrix was not downloaded. Every Lui gene that made the panel was then re-checked in Allen WMB-10X.

full_citation: Pitts EG, Li DC, Gourley SL. A molecularly defined orbitofrontal cortical neuron population controls compulsive-like behavior, but not inflexible choice or habit. Prog Neurobiol. 2024.
